item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We believe this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We must act before that threshold—not count on an off switch afterward.

2. We reject the promise that we can build superintelligent AI first and regain control later. If it is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We demand limits before launch.

3. We cannot switch off a decision we have made irreversible. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We must keep that decision in human hands while it still is.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We cannot treat that threshold as another product launch, another experiment, or another mistake we can correct afterward. We must make our choices before we cross it. We reject promises that we can surrender control today and recover it tomorrow. We demand enforceable limits, public accountability, and the political will to stop development before an irreversible launch. We have a responsibility to defend our collective ability to decide our future—not hand that ability away.
